title: Bandar Abbas AOD z-score leads DHT
hypothesis: R2 | [oil-shipping] Bandar Abbas CAMS AOD 5d z-score > 2 (smoke plumes from struck vessels) leads DHT log returns by 1 day (+); trade long DHT 3d [airquality.bandar_abbas.cams_aod -> finance.DHT.log_return]

trade_idea.entry_rule: airquality.bandar_abbas.cams_aod rolling_zscore_20d > 1 at close -> long DHT next session
trade_idea.exit_rule: close after 5 trading days (no overlapping entries)
trade_idea.caveats: Backtest on daily closes, no costs/slippage; few independent regimes; signal and target may share the war as common cause.

followup_hypothesis: R2 | [oil-shipping] Null control: Bandar Abbas CAMS dust 5d z-score > 2 (natural aerosol, not smoke) leads DHT log returns by 1 day; if it matches the AOD result the AOD signal is just dust [airquality.bandar_abbas.cams_dust -> finance.DHT.log_return] (parent: R2-0015)
